title: Chapter 1376 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy
content:
Chapter 1376 - 3: You Have The Gray Ancestor, I Have The Galaxy

Chapter 1376: Chapter 3: You Have the Gray Ancestor, I Have the Galaxy

"It’s not difficult to deal with; it’s impossible to deal with."

Lord Mo Xu shook his head slightly, then looked at Lin Yuan, "Galaxy, what do you think?"

"My opinion is..."

Lin Yuan smiled and said, "Since we’ve already made a move, we might as well go all the way."

"Go all the way?" Lord Mo Xu looked at Lin Yuan in surprise.

Knowing full well there is a Second Realm time lifeform involved, and yet still wanting to make a move?

Lord Mo Xu could easily deduce more information, such as Lin Yuan having developed means to contend with a Second Realm time lifeform?

Lord Mo Xu highly estimated Lin Yuan’s strength, judging by the size of the time loop area formed when trapped in a time loop, showing formidable power.

Now stepping into the Thirteenth Realm, becoming a time lifeform, his frontal combat ability might already reach the Second Realm level.

Yet frontal combat reaching the Second Realm level does not mean it could contend with an actual Second Realm time lifeform.

"Don’t worry, I have a plan in mind."

Lin Yuan smiled and said.

The struggle of a Thirteenth Realm time lifeform is no longer limited to slaughter, more so it’s about strategizing and planning.

Since Lin Yuan has now stepped into the Thirteenth Realm, he naturally needs to familiarize himself with the combat style of this level.

But with Lin Yuan’s current means, directly choosing a First Realm time lifeform as an opponent.

Would be somewhat bullying.

Choosing a Second Realm time lifeform like Gray Ancestor would be just right.

Moreover, Lin Yuan is quite interested in the Heart of Heavenly River birthed this time by the Milky Way dimension.

This is a rare treasure with the potential to become a lord-level material, of great value. Even if Lin Yuan doesn’t use it himself, he can trade it.

"Keep this item well, and when you encounter danger, just take it out and activate it."

With a move of Lin Yuan’s mind, a jade stone composed of infinite runes appeared in front of him, then flew in front of Lord Mo Xu.

This jade stone was Lin Yuan’s means, condensed through the Rune Dao of the second Origin World, specifically targeting the small axe granted to the Master of Taixu by Gray Ancestor.

"This jade stone?"

Lord Mo Xu observed the jade stone carefully, only feeling that the runes contained within were vast as the Chaos Void.

Other time lifeforms were also in awe, through Lin Yuan’s phrase ’I have a plan’, and this jade stone, even the foolish among them realized Lin Yuan had the confidence to counter a Second Realm time lifeform.

Just entering the Thirteenth Realm First Realm, yet able to contest with a Second Realm time lifeform?

Even having long accepted the many terrifying aspects of Lin Yuan, at this moment all time lifeforms couldn’t help but be shocked.

"Since you, Galaxy, have said so, then leave the time lifeforms of the Taixu dimension to us."

Lord Mo Xu put away the jade stone and immediately said.

The gaze of ’Zhu Yin’ and other time lifeforms also showed their battle intent.

Even the newly-ascended time lifeform Luo Hou was invigorated.

If not for the fact that his realm was not yet stable, he would’ve wanted to head to the Milky Way dimension immediately.

"Gray Ancestor?"

Lin Yuan’s gaze was deep, unable to help but look forward to it.

He also wanted to see how many trump cards a true Second Realm time lifeform would have, to what extent they could push him?

.....

Early on, when Lin Yuan saw a Second Realm time lifeform standing behind the Taixu dimension.

He sent the Taiji Primordial Spirit to the Milky Way dimension.

After stepping into the Thirteenth Realm, the Taiji Primordial Spirit also endured the Chaos Void Origin Infusion.

In addition to the opening of the Constant Sand Particle World.

The combat prowess of the Taiji Primordial Spirit was not much weaker than his true body.

Having the Taiji Primordial Spirit handle matters in the Milky Way dimension was more than enough.

As for Lin Yuan’s true body?

He was contemplating the seventh layer of the "Infinite Void."

The "Infinite Void" is a Thirteenth Realm inheritance, initially originating from Lord Mo Xu’s cultivation of the cosmos within.

The ultimate goal was the Chaos Void.

However, long before stepping into the fifth layer, Lin Yuan made many modifications, especially adding many operational details from the two Origin Worlds.

This led to the inheritance diverging from its original path long ago.

But out of habit, Lin Yuan still considered the seventh layer as the level he needed to cultivate at present.

"The seventh layer, is Lord Mo Xu’s limit, but not my limit. With the potential of my internal cosmos now, there will be an eighth layer, a ninth layer..."

Lin Yuan thought to himself, after integrating the essential operation of the Origin World, his internal cosmos underwent very subtle changes, leading to significant improvements in all aspects.

"How should I open the seventh layer of the ’Infinite Void’?"

Lin Yuan pondered.

The first to the sixth layers of "Infinite Void," had the path created by Lord Mo Xu as reference.

Lin Yuan did not encounter any obstacles.

But the seventh layer?

Even the original "Infinite Void" inheritance only had the seventh layer as a theoretical level, it didn’t actually exist, not even Lord Mo Xu had cultivated it.

Let alone the seventh layer that Lin Yuan developed, which had long veered off the original path, being countless times more difficult.

"My current internal cosmos is approximately one percent the size of the Chaos Void. If I could successfully cultivate the seventh layer, I could fully raise my internal cosmos close to the extent of the Chaos Void before stepping into the Second Realm."

Lin Yuan contemplated, "But how should I open it?"

[Your insight is extraordinary, attempting to open the seventh layer of "Infinite Void," rapidly enhancing your understanding...]

....

A multitude of insights and lights flickered in Lin Yuan’s mind, continuously pushing for the opening of the seventh layer of "Infinite Void."

For a moment, the essence of his internal cosmos.

The essence of the world.

The essence of dimensional space itself.

All emerged bit by bit in Lin Yuan’s mind.

It’s worth mentioning, Lin Yuan had experienced dozens of shuttles, although the dimensional spaces of the earlier shuttles were not powerful, far from matching the Chaos Void.
